blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 84 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) have been repatriated from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, following missile attacks claimed by Yemeni Houthi rebels, the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) announced on Tuesday. In its latest repatriation effort, 50 OFWs arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3 on Tuesday morning via a Qatar Airways flight as OWWA continued its efforts to assist workers affected by flight cancellations in Riyadh. “An additional 50 overseas Filipino workers from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, were repatriated by the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration, in partnership with the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), on […]...
